items.docs: Requests a pre-signed upload location for a zip archive containing the video script and its assets. Returns the pre-signed `url` to PUT the zip to, along with the `repository` and `repositoryType` identifiers to pass to the build endpoint.
Starts an asynchronous video build from a previously uploaded zip archive (or a public zip URL). Returns a JSON object with a `statusUrl` to poll until the build finishes.

Represents polling the pre-signed `statusUrl` returned by the polling audio build and the video build. The actual URL is time-limited and pre-signed, so no API key is required. Poll until `finished` is true, then read the `result` download URL. This path is illustrative; always use the exact statusUrl returned in the build response.
